caption: A coin-cell battery is pressed into a wristwatch lying face up, and the second hand starts to tick.

sa.check: A coin-cell battery is pressed into the watch.
The second hand starts to move.
The second hand is still before the battery goes in.
The order is battery in, then the hand moves.

pc.expect: The second hand is still while the battery is out and starts moving once the battery is seated, and only then.
pc.fail: The battery is in and the second hand stays still to the end of the clip; or the hand moves before the battery reaches the watch; or the hand starts while the battery lies loose beside the watch.

pc.expect: Before the battery is seated nothing on the dial moves; afterwards only the second hand moves, advancing steadily.
pc.fail: The hour or minute hand sweeps round on its own; or the second hand stops and restarts with the battery seated; or the second hand jumps to a new spot on the dial.

pc.expect: The second hand advances clockwise around the dial.
pc.fail: The second hand runs anticlockwise; or swings back and forth about one spot; or reverses part-way round.

pc.expect: The battery stays a rigid flat disc and seats into an opening in the watch; the watch stays put as it is pressed.
pc.fail: The battery bends or squashes under the finger; or the watch slides or flips as the battery is pressed with nothing else touching it; or the battery pops out and hangs in the air.

pc.expect: One watch and one battery; the battery enters an opening rather than sinking through the glass or case; the hands stay attached at the centre.
pc.fail: The battery sinks through the watch glass or the case wall; or a second battery appears or the battery vanishes; or a hand detaches from the centre; or the watch changes shape.

pc.expect: The dial's markings, the strap and the surface beneath stay the same.
pc.fail: The dial numerals change; or the strap changes colour; or the battery changes size.

note: A watch's battery compartment is in the back, hidden when the watch lies face up; the judge accepts whatever opening the battery visibly enters and does not fail the clip for where the compartment is.
